title: Show your first paywall in a SwiftUI app
summary: Add the iOS SDK with Swift Package Manager, show a dashboard-controlled paywall, unlock content with an entitlement and add Restore Purchases.

title: Show your first paywall in an Android app
summary: Add the Android SDK from Maven Central, configure it in your Application class, show a placement's paywall and unlock content with an entitlement.

title: Add a paywall and subscriptions to a Flutter app
summary: Install billdog_flutter, raise the platform minimums, show a placement's paywall on both stores and unlock content with an entitlement.

title: Add a paywall to a React Native or Expo app
summary: Install the SDK with npm or the Expo config plugin, build a development client, show a placement's paywall and gate content on an entitlement.

title: Build a headless web paywall with Stripe checkout
summary: Connect Stripe, fetch a placement's offering with @billdog.io/web, render prices in your own UI, send buyers to checkout and unlock with an entitlement.

title: Keep your app's purchase state current
summary: Listen for customer info changes on every platform, understand what the SDK refreshes for you, and know when to call sync, restore or a forced refresh.

title: Build your own paywall UI in a native app (headless)
summary: Ask BillDog which offering a placement sells, draw the paywall with your own SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, Flutter or React Native code, buy a package, and keep analytics and holdouts honest.

title: Build a paywall from scratch in the visual builder
summary: Go past templates: lay out a paywall, bind product cards to an offering, show live prices and trial text, wire every button, translate it, add tablet and dark layouts, and publish.

title: Offer a free trial on your paywall
summary: Create a free trial in both stores, show trial text only to users who can take it, read whether a customer is in a trial and test the full trial lifecycle.

title: Win back lapsed subscribers with an offer
summary: Create a discount for former subscribers in both stores, serve it from a dedicated win-back paywall, show it only to lapsed users and test the full flow.

title: Recover failed subscription payments
summary: Keep subscribers whose card failed: store grace periods, an in-app banner while access lasts, a message when it ends, and webhooks for your server.

title: Run a scheduled sale with promo codes
summary: Schedule a sale paywall on a placement with start and end dates, add a countdown, create Stripe promotion codes for web checkout and let iOS users redeem offer codes.

title: Sell on the web and unlock in the app with redemption links
summary: Open Stripe checkout from your app, come back through a redemption deep link, and let the SDK redeem the token, grant `premium` and report expired or used links.

title: Sell coins and credits with virtual currency
summary: Create a coin currency, link a consumable pack that grants it, show the balance in your app and spend coins from your server.

title: Connect the App Store to BillDog
summary: Create subscriptions in App Store Connect, give BillDog your In-App Purchase key, point Apple's server notifications at your project and map products to an entitlement.

title: Connect Google Play to BillDog
summary: Create a Google Cloud service account, upload its JSON key, wire real-time developer notifications through Pub/Sub, and map Play base plans to BillDog products.

title: Test real App Store purchases in the sandbox
summary: Buy, renew, restore and cancel a real App Store subscription with a sandbox Apple Account and a BillDog test key, and check each step in the dashboard's Sandbox view.

title: Test real Google Play purchases
summary: Add a license tester, install your internal testing build, buy with a Play test card and watch the purchase and its fast renewals land in BillDog's sandbox.

title: Test purchases without an App Store or Play account
summary: Create sandbox purchases, trials, failed renewals and refunds in the Test Store, then watch your app unlock, all before any store setup.

title: Fix a paywall that doesn't show or has no products
summary: Turn on SDK logging, read what `register` returned, then walk the chain from placement to store products until you find the broken link.

title: Run your first paywall A/B test
summary: Split traffic between two published paywalls, check significance on conversion rate, compare revenue, and ship the winner without an app update.

title: Ship a feature behind a feature flag
summary: Create a flag in the dashboard, read it in your app, roll it out by percentage, target it by user attribute, switch it off instantly and check who saw it.

title: Add sign-in with BillDog Auth
summary: Turn on BillDog Auth, build email and password sign-in with `@billdog.io/auth`, link the session to the user's purchases and verify the token on your Node backend.

title: Track events and build your first funnel
summary: Send custom events from your app, confirm they arrive in the dashboard, then build a funnel from your own event to BillDog's automatic paywall and purchase events.

title: Read your revenue: MRR, churn, refunds and LTV
summary: Find each revenue and subscription metric in the dashboard, learn exactly how it is calculated, and pull it into a CSV or an AI assistant.

title: Send push notifications and in-app messages
summary: Connect APNs and FCM, register the device token in your iOS or Android app, turn on in-app messages, then send a test push and a targeted in-app message from the dashboard.

title: Receive BillDog webhooks on your server
summary: Add a webhook endpoint, verify every delivery's HMAC signature in Node or Python, handle retries safely, and test with a sandbox event.

title: Move from RevenueCat to BillDog
summary: Connect your stores, recreate the catalog, import RevenueCat subscribers, swap the SDK calls and point server notifications at BillDog without anyone losing access.

title: Move from raw StoreKit or Play Billing to BillDog
summary: Connect your stores, bring existing subscribers across, point App Store and Play notifications at BillDog, then hand purchases to the SDK or keep your own code in observer mode.

title: Build and publish a paywall with an AI assistant
summary: Connect Claude Code, Claude, Cursor or another MCP client to BillDog, and have the agent design, preview, publish and place a paywall for you.
